messages:
deploybot: Planned staged cutover for inference-service v2. Target flag: `ff.inference.switch_v2`. Window: 2026-03-22 03:30-04:30 UTC. Plan: 0% -> 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 8m observation at each step. Canary model pinned to `model-inference-2.1.0-canary`. Who's owning telemetry and rollback?

natalie: I can drive rollout. I'll coordinate telemetry and give go/no-go at each gate. Thresholds posted below.

ops_ryan: oncall here. Rollback command: `deploybot rollback-tag inference-service:v1.14.8` and `deploybot unpin-model canary`. If any regional 5xx or queue depth spike happens, hit pause.

qe_lee: QE will run a short smoke list against canary cohort after 2% and 10% stages. Quick checks: basic prompt sanity, output length variance, and deterministic edge-case prompts.

pm_ana: I'll update the release notes with known prompt differences and a customer-facing note if we need a rollback.

telemetry-bot: Registered monitoring: error_rate, p95_latency, CPU_util, token_cost. Alert triggers: error_rate increase >0.5pp vs baseline OR p95 +80ms sustained across two 5m windows -> auto-pause suggestion.

deploybot: Executing initial pin: `deploybot pin-model inference-service model-inference-2.1.0-canary --cohort=canary --annot "staged-cutover-2026-03-22"`. Pin success.

natalie: kicking off soft-launch -> 2% in 90s. Command: `redwood-ff set ff.inference.switch_v2=2% --actor natalie --note "soft launch"`

deploybot: Flag set to 2%. Observability hooks started. ETA to next gate ~8m.

qe_lee: running smoke now, posting results in 6m.

telemetry-bot: +8m metrics: error_rate=0.06%, p95 +12ms, cpu +1.2%, token_cost +0.2%. No alerts.

natalie: ok to proceed to 10%. Moving in 60s.

ops_ryan: reminder: keep slack open and pager reachable. If we see region-specific anomalies, we narrow the cohort by region flag.

deploybot: Flag ramp -> 10%. Command executed.

qe_lee: smoke pass for 10% looks good, found one prompt that changed formatting for list bullets. Filing a minor bug INFR-3122. Not blocking rollout.

pm_ana: added known formatting quirk to release notes under "known issues".

telemetry-bot: +8m metrics at 10%: error_rate=0.14%, p95 +22ms, token_cost +0.5%. Still under thresholds.

natalie: moving to 40% now. If we hit error_rate >=0.8% or p95 +100ms for two consecutive windows we pause and rollback.

deploybot: Ramp to 40% in progress.

telemetry-bot: +8m at 40%: error_rate=0.95% -> ALERT. Suggest pause and rollback. Details: spike concentrated in eu-west region (increased queue depth).

ops_ryan: acknowledging alert. Executing `deploybot pause ff.inference.switch_v2` now. Please prepare rollback steps.

deploybot: Flag paused. Current flag percentage frozen at 40%.

natalie: halting rollout. QE stop further ramp. @ops_ryan please run rollback-tag and unpin canary.

ops_ryan: Executing: `deploybot rollback-tag inference-service:v1.14.8 --reason "eu-west queue spike at 40%"` then `deploybot unpin-model inference-service model-inference-2.1.0-canary`.

deploybot: Rollback command accepted. Rollback in progress. Unpin executed.

telemetry-bot: Rolling metrics coming through: error_rate returning toward baseline. Will post 10m summary.

qe_lee: QE validated smoke against rollback, outputs match v1.14.8 baseline. No regressions after rollback.

pm_ana: marking release notes as draft rollback occurred: noted cause and mitigation plan to retry after infra fix.

natalie: summary: paused and rolled back due to eu-west queue pressure causing elevated errors. Infra/Platform to investigate root cause (autoscaling behavior for v2 runtime). We'll regroup tomorrow for a second attempt after mitigation. Runbook ID: RB-2026-031-1712. Closing this cutover thread, keeping logs attached.

ops_ryan: filing an incident ticket INC-2026-451 with infra. Adding logs and timeline.

deploybot: Cutover aborted and logged. If we reschedule, start a new thread with a new runbook id."
